recognize_zh: 淋巴結觸片（Diff-Quik 類染色）中大量小淋巴球背景下散布許多大型組織球，細胞質淡藍豐富，內部包含數顆完整的淋巴球（emperipolesis），是 Rosai-Dorfman 病在細胞學上的關鍵線索。
features: Highly cellular touch preparation dominated by small round lymphocytes with a polymorphous mixture of cell sizes
Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Intact small lymphocytes enclosed within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis), several per cell
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval, pale and vesicular, partially obscured by engulfed cells
Scattered clear vacuoles/lipid droplets in the background; no cohesive epithelial clusters
describe_en: Touch preparation of lymph node (Romanowsky-type stain) shows a cellular smear composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with admixed larger lymphoid cells. Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm are distributed throughout, many containing multiple intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis. There are no cohesive tumor clusters or Reed-Sternberg-like cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease, to be confirmed on tissue with S100-positive, CD1a-negative histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophages in reactive follicular hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact viable lymphocytes and are S100 negative.
Macrophages ingest red cells, platelets and nuclear debris that are being digested, rather than intact lymphocytes in clear vacuoles.
Cytology shows grooved, folded nuclei and eosinophils without emperipolesis, with CD1a/langerin positivity.
